topic: The 10 Minutes Was Never the Business Model (quick commerce basket-size economics)
central_idea: Quick commerce apps compete on average order value, not delivery speed, because a dark store's fixed costs (rent, staff, inventory) do not shrink for a small basket, and fee/nudge prompts exist to raise basket size.
engagement_goal: Comments and shares: reframes a near-daily quick-commerce order with a specific business mechanism, closes with a personal-experience comment question.
